create_match_validator: create a validator function that checks if a tree node has valid mamba cache data
finalize_match_result: finalize a prefix match result by copying mamba state using copy-on-write for request isolation
commit_insert_component_data: commit mamba cache data to a tree node updating LRU lists and evictable size tracking
evict_component: evict mamba cache entries from a tree node freeing pool indices and updating size counters
prepare_for_caching_req: prepare mamba cache indices for a request supporting extra buffer and fork allocation with eviction fallback
